basic_details.short_information: Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has invited applications for 31 posts in 6 roles under Advt No. ED/KEA/40/Ne.Vi/2026 (KK). The posts include Assistant Town Planner, Junior Engineer (Civil) - Karnataka Housing Board, Junior Engineer (Civil) - Greater Bengaluru Authority, Junior Engineer (Mines and Geology) and 2 more. The online application is open from 31 October 2026 to 26 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Open the KEA website https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/ and select the link provided.
Read all eligibility instructions, then fill in the online application.
Enter the correct RD number when claiming reservation.
Check every detail, because no information can be changed after submission.
important_instructions: Post-wise and category-wise details are published separately, are provisional and may be revised on Government orders. Exam centre details will be announced later, and the centre cannot be changed for any reason. Reservation not claimed in the application cannot be added later. A wrongly claimed reservation can be deleted in the Candidate Verification Slip only before mock allotment begins. KEA does not verify original documents; the appointing authority does. This notification is linked in counselling with KEA notification ED/KEA/41/Ne.Vi/2026(RPC) dated 30-10-2026 for posts with the same syllabus.

content_sections.heading: How Will KEA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Competitive examination: Paper-1 and Paper-2 (Offline OMR) Qualifying Kannada Language Test, unless exempted Merit or rank based on percentage of total marks Online counselling with option entry, Candidate Verification Slip and mock allotment Provisional selection list in 1:1 ratio Final selection list and additional list Verification of original documents by the appointing authority Selection is on total marks in the competitive examination, eligibility and reservation rules, through online counselling. Options are entered online through login after the result; they cannot be submitted by hand or post. Each candidate may be selected for only one post through counselling. If marks tie, the older candidate ranks higher; if age also ties, higher marks in the qualifying examination decide.

content_sections.heading: KEA Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Offline OMR examination with objective multiple-choice questions and 4 answer options. Minimum 35% marks required to qualify in the competitive examination. 0.25 mark deducted for each wrong answer. A fifth OMR option must be shaded for unanswered questions, or 0.25 mark is deducted per question. Five extra minutes are given after the last bell for shading the fifth option. Compulsory Kannada test: maximum 150 marks, minimum 50 marks; marks do not count for selection or seniority.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original marks cards and qualification certificates at document verification. Caste or reservation certificate in the prescribed form, with RD number. Rural candidates: Form-1 (where applicable) with RD number and Form-2 certified by the headmaster and countersigned by the Block Education Officer. Kannada medium certificate for Classes 1 to 10, signed and sealed by the school headmaster. Original photo ID at the exam centre, with the admit card.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KEA Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Open the KEA website https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/ and select the link provided. Read all eligibility instructions, then fill in the online application. Enter the correct RD number when claiming reservation. Check every detail, because no information can be changed after submission. Pay the fee online by 27-11-2026. Apply on or before 26 November 2026.
